fieldValues.title: Where does multi-user, federated, fractal memory belong in the programme?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. The owner named it an important part of the future (vignette e83f2d33); today it has no single home beyond this Research thread.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Widen the Agent memory domain, whose purpose today speaks of an agent across sessions, not a group.
- B. A new domain nested in Deep context, beside Agent memory and Group meaning ownership.
- C. No new home: Group meaning ownership, the federation strategy contract 586cd1ec and the Dreamtime thread carry their parts, joined only by this thread.

Separately: whether it gets an epic on the roadmap, and when.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: What would choose: whether problems SP-161, SP-162, SP-34, SP-50 and SP-86 keep landing together, and whether a pilot with a live group produces work that fits none of the existing domains.
fieldValues.next_action: Watch where evidence lands as the thread grows.
